candidates.source_title: The Queen Who Was Pregnant 24 Times… #history
candidates.source_description:
Queen Maria Luisa of Parma, wife of King Charles IV of Spain, endured 24 pregnancies during her lifetime. Only 14 resulted in live births, and just seven of her children survived to adulthood.
The physical toll was enormous. Years of repeated pregnancies reportedly affected her appearance, and she eventually lost her teeth. Despite fulfilling one of the most important expectations placed on royal women—producing heirs—she was frequently mocked for her appearance.
